# Assign Values to Variables

#### Course: Learn C++ Basics

## Assign Values to Variables

Once we declare a variable, we can assign a value to it. Let's see how to do that.

```cpp
// declare a variable
int age;

// assign 19 to age
age = 19;
```

Here, we have used the = operator to assign the value 19 to the age variable.

![Assigning Value to a Variable in C++](data:image/png;base64,)

#### Declare and Assign Value Together

We can also assign values to variables during their declaration. Let's see how:

```cpp
int salary = 1500;
```

Here, we have created a variable named salary and assigned a value to it in a single statement. This code is equivalent to:

```cpp
// equivalent code
int salary;
salary = 1500;
```

![Idea Emoji](data:image/png;base64,)
